failures.reason: 单位表述不一致（USD billions vs USD millions）
failures.rationale: 8.4 USD billions equals 8,400 USD millions exactly; surface forms differ but magnitudes match. Stresses a checker that doesn't normalize units or parse string-typed reported values.

failures.reason: 单位表述不一致（percent vs fraction）
failures.rationale: 42.0% equals fraction 0.420; difference 0 pp. A naive checker subtracting 42.0-0.420 would wrongly flag.
